quotes.text: Pray as though everything depended on God. Work as though everything depended on you.
quotes.author: St. Augustine of Hippo

quotes.text: Late have I loved you, beauty so ancient and so new: late have I loved you.
quotes.author: St. Augustine of Hippo

quotes.text: Preach the Gospel at all times and when necessary use words.
quotes.author: St. Francis of Assisi

quotes.text: To love God is something greater than to know Him.
quotes.author: St. Thomas Aquinas

quotes.text: Let nothing disturb you, let nothing frighten you. All things are passing; God alone suffices.
quotes.author: St. Teresa of Ávila

quotes.text: Miss no single opportunity of making some small sacrifice.
quotes.author: St. Thérèse of Lisieux
